firm_data.firm_name: Hartmann Doherty Rosa Berman & Bulbulia LLP
firm_data.firm_description: HDRB&B is a full service law firm providing creative, committed, and cost-effective legal services to both corporate and individual clients in New Jersey, New York, and Florida. They represent clients in complex commercial litigation, white-collar criminal prosecutions, government investigations, class action defense, employment law counseling & litigation, corporate transactions, commercial real estate transactions, trusts & estates planning, estate litigation, and matrimonial law.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in New Jersey, New York, and Florida.
HDRB&B attorneys have earned the respect of the legal community and are recognized for their skill and experience by colleagues, adversaries and judges.

email.subject: AI for Hartmann Doherty Rosa Berman & Bulbulia LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Paul,

Your firm handles complex commercial litigation, white-collar criminal prosecutions, and corporate transactions across New Jersey, New York, and Florida. That kind of footprint demands both precision and speed, especially when competing for sophisticated clients.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet firms doing exactly what you do. I'd be happy to stop by your Hackensack office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
